notes.title: v0.38.5
notes.content:
[u]Improvements[/u]
- When joining a game via code, allow an already-joined player to re-join the game instead of sending back an error message

[u]Fixes[/u]
- Fix bug in online matches where the "Results" popup wouldn't appear when the game finished
- Don't allow users to resign when the game is already over (by draw or by winning)
